GlassesGate reaches your glasses through the Meta AI app. It only ever asks whether a session is open — it never sees the camera, the microphone, or anything you look at.

The beacon only transmits while your glasses are connected and on your face. Take them off, fold them, or walk out of range and it stops within seconds — and starts again by itself when they\'re back.
